annotations.title: Drive animation in the running game

description:
Read and drive animation in the RUNNING game: AnimationPlayer clips, AnimationTree states and Skeleton3D bone poses. cmd state only reads. Prove motion with two reads around summer_game_control step.
Guide: summer_docs_read {"id":"tool/runtime-animate"}

blend.description: target:'player' play — custom blend time in seconds.

bones.description: target:'bones' — bone names to read (omit for the first 256; page larger rigs with this filter).

cmd.description: Default 'state' (read-only). target:'player': state|play|pause|stop|seek|speed. target:'tree': state|travel|start|stop|set_param|get_param. Ignored for target:'bones'.

from_end.description: target:'player' play — start from the end (backwards).

include_rest.description: target:'bones' — also return each bone's rest Transform3D.

instance.description: Game instance to address (default 'main' = the editor's embedded game).

name.description: target:'player' play — clip name (unknown_animation lists the clips).

path.description: ABSOLUTE runtime path of the AnimationPlayer / AnimationTree / Skeleton3D.

playback_path.description: target:'tree' — state machine playback parameter (default 'parameters/playback'; nested machines use 'parameters/<Node>/playback').

reset.description: target:'tree' travel/start — reset the destination clip (default true).

speed.description: target:'player' speed — speed_scale (1.0 = normal, negative plays backwards).

state.description: target:'tree' travel/start — state machine node name (unknown_state lists them).

target.description: 'player' = AnimationPlayer (RuntimeAnimation), 'tree' = AnimationTree state machine (RuntimeAnimationTree), 'bones' = Skeleton3D poses (GetRuntimeBones).

update.description: target:'player' seek — apply the pose immediately (default true).

value.description: target:'tree' set_param — new value (JSON scalar or Godot literal string).

name: summer_runtime_animate
title: Drive animation in the running game
